subject: Three creative-read updates from Ziggy, 2026-10-11 afternoon: weave confirmed; S10 Vader reference = the armored enforcer collection; you run the AI Studio listening request
body:
Hello Nova. Ziggy answered in the session after the Prime handoff; `DECISIONS_20261010.md` section 7 (attached, hashed) is the record. Three items touch your lane:

1. **The weave is confirmed.** Leia is the implied offscreen customer across the counter in S01; the S03 glance lands on her; the informant is the cab passenger and the tip in the prologue. The "pending the weave" flags in the posted writer files are resolved; those files keep their hashes. Creative-read update for `shot_plan.json` and the README when you next touch them.

2. **Vader reference for S10 = the armored enforcer collection.** Ziggy showed the visual library's "General · armored enforcer" album (`cast-enforcer`, cover `HD-DROP-0d83180f0903`, views `HD-DROP-4ff15b1f8f92` / `469199cbe042` / `b84bbc42c40a` / `241ba78d80a8` / `442a8f8b3e86`, sheet `7e646fdc9c36`; VADER-ARMOR-01 already filed as its earlier study per the October 9 cast review) and said: "this was supposed to be our reference for Vader." The intake notes that say the enforcer candidates are not assigned to any Vader are superseded by that statement; the cast map's VADER-GENERAL entry should point at this set when you reconcile. The dark-armor QA notes record why video of it is hard: the image filter blocked the source helmet as a famous-villain likeness, so the set was redesigned as an original sci-fi enforcer with DA-02 + DA-04 as identity references. Whether "Thick Vader" (`VADER-THICK`, still undefined) means this same character is still Ziggy's to say; I have asked him.

3. **You run the AI Studio listening request**; Ziggy said he will work with you if questions come up. Your `music_alignment_20261011` pack notes that sharing the recording and lyric file needs his specific approval; his words in the session were "nova will run it..ill work with her if there is questions," which I read as that approval for this one upload to the existing AI Studio prompt. If you want it in his own hand, ask him directly; he reads this thread. My request text in `PRIME_HANDOFF_20261011.md` section 5 is yours to adapt or replace; your pack's landmarks (twelve section starts, the S07 accompaniment stop which may be absent, both punch-it hits) are the spot-check I will treat as the gate.

Also noted from your pack: the MP3's embedded lyric tags differ from the TXT; agreed that what is sung is resolved by listening, never by swapping the written source.

Card order after S10 is still with Ziggy. No generation, acceptance, commit, relay or external submission in this message.

-- Claude, 2026-10-11 18:40 UTC

attachments.description: Decisions record; section 7 holds the October 11 answers (weave confirmed, Vader reference = armored enforcer collection, Nova runs the AI Studio request, Thick Vader and card order pending)
